tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sngags kyi klog tshul dang yi ge'i khams kyi sdeb sbyor mdor bsdus don gsal phrin

las kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti pra dze bhyaḥ gang sku ri bong 'dzin pa'i ngos// mtshan dpe'i 'od kyis kun nas 'khyud// snying gi mun sel 'jam dpal dbyangs// bdag blo'i ku muta rtag skyongs shig /'dir sngags kyi klog tshul mdo tsam brjod pa la/ dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi klog tshul gnyis las/ dang po la dbyangs dngos dang*/ de gsal byed kyi srog tu zhugs tshul gnyis so// dang po ni/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū rnams kyi a i u rnams thung ngu ste/ mig 'dzum gcig gi yun du bklag par bya'o// ā ī ū rnams ring po ste/ mig 'dzum gnyis kyi yun du klog cing*/ na ro dang 'greng bu yod pa rnams kyang ring por bklag go// gnyis pa gsal byed kyi srog tu zhugs pa/ ka kā/ ki kī/ ku kū rnams gong bzhin/ ka ki ku rnams thung ngu dang*/ kā kī kū rnams ring por bklag par bya ste/ de bzhin du gsal byed gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o// ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ zhes pa snga ma ni bsgrims pa'i tshul du rir rīr zhes pa dang*/ phyi ma glod pa'i tshul du lil līl zhes par bklag go| |de srog tu zhugs pa/ kṛ kṝ/ kl̥ kl̥̄ lta bu la'ang*/ kir kīr/ kil kīl zhes par bklag go// e ai/ o au la/ e dang o gnyis ring po la 'greng bu nyis brtsegs te o i dang*/ na ro nyis brtsegs ring po la o u zhes e dang o gnyis thung ngu phral tshul du bklag go// de srog tu zhugs pa/ ke kai/ ko kau la'ang*| ke kai i/ ko kau u zhes gong bzhin bklag go// a la thig le nga ru 'don pa ste ang zhes pa'o// de gsal byed kyang srog tu zhugs pa la/ pha rol gyi tshig grogs la ltos pas tshig grogs la/ ka kha ga gha nga rnams byung na klad skor nga ru klog cing*/ de bzhin du/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya rnams la nya ru bklag /ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa rnams la ṇa ru bklag /ta tha da dha na rnams la na ru bklag

/pa pha ba bha ma rnams la ma ru klog cing*/ nya ṇa gnyis kyang na bzhin bklag par 'thad do// tshig grogs med par shad kyis chod na rang thog brtsi ba ste/ ka sde la nga dang*/ tsa sde/ ṭa sde/ ta sde rnams la na ru dang*/ pa sde la ma ru bklag go// ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥrnams la phal cher nga ru bklag par bya ste dbyangs rnams la'ang ngo*// aḥzhes pa'i rnam bcad la drag por bcad nas klog cing*/ pha rol tu sha ṣa sa gsum byung na rnam bcad sa ru bklag ste/ dper na/ na maḥshākya mu nā ye dang*/ na maḥṣa ḍaṃ ga dang*/ na maḥs manta lta bu la/ na mas shes bklag go/ ༈ /gnyis pa gsal byed kyi klog tshul la/ rkyang pa dang brtsegs pa'i klog tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sde tshan gyi yi ge dang po ka tsa ṭa ta pa/ gnyis pa/ kha tsha ṭha tha pha rnams bod dang mtshungs pa las/ ṭa ṭha gnyis tra thra lta bu la ring sgra med par lce rtse rkan la sbyar nas tigs kyis bskyur bar bya ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i ḍa ḍha ṇa rnams kyang 'gre'o// gsum pa/ ga dza ḍa da ba rnams sngags kyi thog mar byung na 'as 'phul bzhin du bklag ste/ dper na/ ga ga na/ dza yantu/ ḍā ki nī/ da ha na/ ba lingta rnams la/ 'ga' ga na/ 'dza' yantu/ 'dra ki nī/ 'da' ha na/ 'ba' lingta zhes bklags la/ de rnams sngags kyi dbus dang tha mar byung na bod ltar bklags te/ dper na/ bha ga wān/ kha ṭwāṃ ga rā dzā ya/ pañdza/ daṇḍinna/ khaṇḍa/ bi da ra ṇa/ ā nanda/ ma hā brta/ swa bhā wa rnams la/ ga dza ḍa da ba zhes rang sor bklag go// bzhi pa/ gha dzha ḍha dha bha rnams ra mgo yod pa lta bu la ha'i sgra cung zad ldan par bklag ste/ rga rdza ḍha rda rba zhes ha sgra dang bcas te bklag go// lnga pa/ nga nya ṇa ma rnams kyi ṇa gong du smos pa ltar dang*/ gzhan rnams bod dang mtshungs la/ nya ṇa gnyis tshig grogs su byung na yar sbyar nas na ru bklag ste/ bhañdza dang*/ piṇḍa lta bu la/ bhan dza dang*/ pin ḍa zhes bklag go// ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha rnams rang sor klog cing*/

sha ṣa gnyis tshig grogs su byung na yar sbyar nas sa ltar bklag ste/ dper na/ na mashtsaṇḍa dang*/ tiṣṭha lta bu la/ na mas dang tis ṭha zhes bklag go// ka yar sbyar nas ga ltar bklag ste/ wākka lta bu la wag ka zhes klog cing*/ tsakra dang wakye lta bu la kas nyis go bcad nas/ tsag kra dang wag kye zhes bklag go// tsa ṭa ta rnams yar sbyar zhing 'di ltar bklag ste/ gatstshaḥ aṭṭa/ utpa lta bu la/ gad tsha/ ad ṭa/ ud pa/ zhes bklag go// satwa lta bu la tas nyis go bcad de/ sad twa zhes bklag go// pa yar sbyar nas ba ltar bklag ste/ shapta lta bu la shab ta zhes bklag go/ ༈ /gnyis pa brtsegs ma'i klog tshul ni/ 'dra ba'i gsal byed brtsegs na skad kyi gdangs mthon pos bklag ste/ dharm+ma lta bu'i ma shin tu ring bar kha khengs mthon pos bklag go// plu ta'ang de bzhin du shin tu ring ba ste/ mig 'dzum gsum gyi yun du bklag pa ste/ shuddho3haṃ dang ātma ko3haṃ lta bu'o/ */ gsal byed mi 'dra ba brtsegs pa ham̐kṣ+malawaraya lta bu la/ ha kṣa ma la ba ra ya zhes pa sgra thon tsam du phral nas myur por bklag go/ /yang tshig grogs yod na gong ma yar sbyar nas 'og ma rnams dkyus klog pa ste/ dper na/ buddha dang*/ sambha ra lta bu la da dang ma yar sbyar nas/ bud dha dang*/ sam bha ra zhes bklag go// gsal byed brtsegs pa'i steng du dbyangs dang klad kor yod na 'og ma la sbyar te/ dper na/ sthi ra dang*/ spho ṭā ya lta bu la/ sa thi ra dang*/ sa pho ṭā ya zhes dang*/ klad kor yod pa brtsegs pa gong gi ha kṣa ma la ba ra ya rnams kyi steng du klad kor raṃ nga ro yod na 'og ma ya la sbyar nas yang zhes dang*/ duṣṭaṃ lta bu la/ dus ṭaṃ zhes 'og mar sbyar nas bklag go// ka la ṣa btags pa la khya zhes klog cing*/ rakṣa lta bu la kas gnyis go bcad nas rag kṣa zhes bklag go// dza la nya btags pa la 'gya'am/ gnya' gang rung du bklag go// ya btags phal cher 'greng bu la ya'i sgra cung zad ldan par bklag ste/

bhya dang*/ bi dya'aṃ/ birgya lta bu la/ bhi dang*/ bi de dang*/ birge thung ngu la ya'i sgra dang bcas bklags la/ yang bhyo dang*/ dyu lta bu la phral nas/ bha yo dang*/ da yu zhes klog cing*/ ka kha'i ya btags bod dang mthun te/ wakakye dang*/ tri khye ta lta bu la/ waka kye dang*/ tri khye ta zhes bod ltar bklag go// wa btags phal cher na ro la wa'i sgra ldan par bklag ste/ swa sti dang*/ sha ra dwa ti lta bu la/ sos ti dang*/ sha ra do ti zhes thung ngu la wa'i sgra cung zad ldan par bklag go// dwi dang twe lta bu la/ phral nas da wi dang ta we zhes bklag go/ ra dang hwa lta bu la/ a ka a pa ces pa'am/ yang na/ ko wa po wa zhes bklag par bya ba yin no// de ltar sngags kyi bklag tshul la lo tsā ba so so'i dgongs bzhed mi mthun pa mang yang rgyas par yi ger 'jigs shing*/ 'dir ni don thob cha shas tsam smos pas 'khyer bde bar byas shing*/ dbyangs yig gsal byed so so'i srog tu zhugs pa sogs kyang rigs 'gre shes par bya'o// ༈ //kun la nyer mkho yi ge yi// khams kyi sbyor ba la brten nas// rnal 'byor lha sngags phrin las sgrub// shis dang mi shis rtogs 'dod na// sngags kyi ma bu dgra grogs bstan// a ku ha ranam mkha'i khams// zhes pa a ā gnyis dang*/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ ha dang radagu po nam mkha'i khams yin la/ de bzhin du/ i tsu ya sha rlung gi khams ni/ i ī dang*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya dang*/ ya sha dgu rlung gi khams/ ri ṭu ra ṣa me yi khams ni/ ṛ ṝ dang*/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa dang*| ra ṣa dgu ni me'o/ u su 'a sa chu'i khams ni/ u ū dang*/ pa pha ba bha ma dang*/ wa hwa dgu ni chu'i khams dang*/ l̥ tu la sa sa yi khams/ zhes pa/ l̥ l̥̄ dang*/ ta tha da dha na dang*/ la dang sa bsdoms pa dgu po sa yi khams te/ de rnams 'byung chen ngos bzung yin// 'byung ba chung ba sde lnga ni// dbyangs la 'byung chung rtsi rgyu med/ ka tsa ṭa ta pa rnams sa// kha cha ṭha tha pha rnams chu// ga dza ḍa da ba rnams me// gha dzha ḍha dha bha rnams rlung*// nga nya ṇa na ma rnams mkha'// aṃ a kṣa sogs klad kor dang*// thig le tsheg dragaḥcan rnams dang*// mthar gnas ye shes yi ge zhes// nam mkha' lta bu kun gyi grogs// ca cha ja zha sha za 'a drug

/'byung chen dang mthun nam mkha'i khams// 'byung ba chung ba'i dus su ni| |sa me rlung sa nam mkha' ru// bzhed kyang bsdu ba'i bsdu ba'i bzhed lugs mang na'ang*// rang lugs bod yig ca cha ja// tsa tsha dza la rim bsdu zhing*// zha sha za sa 'a ya ru// bsdu zhing khams ni de ltar brtsi// khams dang bstun// rang gi lha yi rtsa sngags kyi// oṃ dang na mo tadya thā// spangs pa'i sngags kyi thog ma dang*// rang gi ming yig thog ma gnyis// dgra bshes bran gyi rten 'brel brtag /gsal byed brtsegs sam phul bzhag yod// dang po'i yi ge gzung bar bya// dbyangs yig dgrar gyur srog dang 'bral// gsal byed dgrar gyur nad mang 'gyur// de yang sa yi dgrar gyur na// bad kan sa nad gtogs pa 'byung*// phyi rol khang pa zhig pa dang*// sa 'og lhung nas gnod sogs 'byung*// chu yi dgrar gyur chu nad dang*// grang ba shas che'i nad ldang zhing*| |phyi rol sgo phyugs chus 'khyer dang*// sa zhing shwa 'od kyis 'ded 'byung*// me yi dgrar gyur mkhris rims dang*// tshad nad phyi rol mes tshig 'byung*// rlung yig dgrar gyur rlung nad ldang*// khang pa rtsi shing rlung gis 'jig /des na dgra grogs brtsi bar gces// sa dgra me yin me dgra chu// chu dgra rlung yin rlung dgra sa// sa ni me la nus pa med// me ni chu la nus pa med// chu ni rlung la nus pa med// rlung gi sa la nus pa med// sa chu phan tshun grogs yin te// me rlung phan tshun grogs po yin// nam mkha' kun gyi grogs yin te// kun kyang nam mkha'i grogs su gyur// dgrar gyur srog lus nad kyis 'debs// dgra grogs gang med 'bras bu med// grogs su byung ba dngos grub 'byung*| |dbyangs yig gsal byed dgrar gyur dang*// gsal byed dbyangs la dgra grogs 'gyur// la la 'di ltar 'dod pa yod// dbyangs yig dbyangs yig dgra grogs 'gyur// de bzhin gsal byed gyur pa ste// dbyangs yig dang ni gsal byed gnyis// gcig la gcig gis dgrar mi 'gyur// phan tshun thabs dang shes rab ste// gcig la gcig gis grogs yin no// 'byung ba nang phrad pa la'ang bshad// sa nang phrad pa rgyas las shis// 'ga' zhig sa nad reng bar byed// 'di la reng byed las 'gyur bzhed// chu nang phrad pas zhi ba de// sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i las sogs shis// me nang phrad pas dbang du byed// dbang sdud las rnams shis pa yin// drag po'i las la'ang shis kyang zer// rlung nang phrad pas sdang bar byed| |phyir skrod la sogs drag las bzang*// nam mkha' nang 'phrad gso bar byed// nad pa sri'u gso la shis// ye shes dang ni nam mkha' gnyis// nang 'phrad lus can skyed par byed| |ye shes rlung gis 'chi bar byed// 'di la mthu byed dge bar bshad// ye shes me yis 'khrug byed de// dbye ba'i las la shis pa yin// ye shes sa yis lhung ba las// slar ni lhong bar byed pa'o// lha dang rang nyid ji bzhin du// bla dpon gnyen grogs 'khor g.yog sogs// ming gi yi ge dang po'i khams// mthun pa'i thabs gtso mi mthun ngan// btags ming bla dwags rnam pa gnyis// gang 'bod grags che brtsi ba'o// mi mthun mthun ming bsgyur la bya// gzhan yang srung bar byed pa la// nad pa'i nad de gang yin brtag

/de yi gnyen por 'gro ba yi// yi ge byas na shis pa ste// nad ni mkhris me bad kan sa// khrag chu rlung rlung 'dus pa 'dus// nad pa rang la kho rang gi// grogs su 'gro ba'i yi ge byed// mthu byed rang dang lha'i yi ge// dang po dgra ming dgra 'gro bya// go log gyur na bsgyur bas 'grub// bsgyur ba'i gsang sngags 'di bzlas pas// dgrar gyur bran 'gyur gang byung 'grub// 'bum phrag drug tu bzlas pa na// sngags ni myur du 'grub 'gyur bas// bsnyen pa'i gong du 'di nyid brjod// oṃ haṃ sarba buddha zhes// de ni nam mkha' sgyur byed sngags// oṃ yaṃ sarba buddha rlung*// oṃ laṃ sarba buddha sa// oṃ raṃ sarba buddha me// oṃ baṃ sarba buddha chu// oṃ aṃ sarba buddha zhes/ sngags la ngar btags lha byin skyed// dgra ni gshis bsgyur bran du bcad// de lta'i yon tan dpag med yin// dbyangs la 'byung chen 'byung chung gi// dgra grogs mi mthun mthun byed brtsi// de phyir ma nor legs par brtag /'byung ba che chung mthun par rab// 'byung chen mthun pa 'bring po yin// 'byung chung mthun pa tha ma dang*/ mi mthun pa ni tha chad do// gzhan yang snga 'gyur sdeb rgyud las// mi 'dra'i khyad par 'di ltar bshad// gsal byed sum cu so bzhi yi// sde lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga po// sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste// 'byung ba chen po lnga ru sbyar// ka sde sa yin tsa sde chu// ṭa sde me yin ta sde rlung*| |pa sde nam mkha'i yi ge'o// 'byung chung nyi shu rtsa lnga ni// rang sde'i dang po sa yin zhing*// gnyis pa chu yin gsum pa me// bzhi pa rlung yin lnga pa mkha'// mthar gnas yi ge 'bru bzhi ni// rim bzhin rlung me chu sa yin// dro ba bzhi dang mthar zad gcig /rim bzhin chu me sa nam mkha'// dbyangs yig a ā aṃ aḥmakha'// i ī sa yin e ai me// u ū chu la o au rlung*// ṛ ṝ me yin l̥ l̥̄ sa// dgra grogs brtsi tshul gong dang mtshungs/

so so'i lugs la dgos pa re// yod phyir bsre lhad dogs ngan spongs// zhib par re'u mig blta ba gces/ /zhes gsungs/ sngags kyi klog tshul dang khams kyi rtsi sbyor rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'dir ni don bsdus rags pa tsam du dharma kīrtis bkod pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// 'byung chung rtsi sachu me rlung mkha'a'abyung chen rtsi lugs 'phred mkha'arlung mechus 'byung chen gzhung ngam thur 'ded lugs thur 'ded i.ī.u e.ai o a.ā'aded 'byung khams rim a i ṛ.ul̥ du brtsi ba'o// dam gzhung 'ded/ l̥l̥̄.ū ṛṝ au aṃ.aḥbartsegs bzhin no// ā.ī ṝ.ūl̥̄s la kakha ga gha ngas i.ī l̥l̥̄ i.i' l̥l̥̄ katsa ṭapatacasachu wa tsatsha dza dzha nyasha u.ū u ū khatsha ṭhaphathachachu me ra ṭaṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa' e.ai ṛṝ e.ai ṛṝ gadza ḍabadajame rlung ya tatha da dha naha o au o au ghadzha ḍhabhadharlung mkha' 0 papha ba bha makṣa a.ā aṃ.aḥ a.ā aṃ.aḥ nganya ṇamanamakha' lawa ra ya 0 haya rawala'abyung chung 'di nas 'phred 'ded du sasha ṣa ha kṣa rasha ṣahwasabartsi'o//
